## About
Miami Clutch & Transmission is a family operated business, and we call ourselves the oldest clutch house in Miami. Clutches are what we know, whether it's for your car, your truck or industrial work.
We keep our rates competitive with no hidden fees, and we try to give every customer real attention and personal service. One reviewer said we took the time to explain how to drive to make a new clutch last.

## Services
- Clutches for automotive, industrial and truck applications: Clutch work for most automotive, industrial and truck applications.
- Transmission service: Transmission work alongside our clutch service.

## FAQ
Q: Do you handle truck and industrial clutches?
A: Yes. We offer clutches for most automotive, industrial and truck applications.

Q: Do you offer Seco and Spicer/Eaton?
A: Yes, Seco and Spicer/Eaton are among what we offer.

Q: Can I reach you by email?
A: Yes, you can email the shop at miamiclutch@att.net.
